source.note: workspace/ is the tree exported from the recorded checkout, with the path sanitizations recorded below. No metric value anywhere in this task was altered.

Per CONTRIBUTING: weights are never shipped in the task.
Deleted before packaging, so no per-sample dumps are included. The per-step trace under workspace/outputs/ carries the evidence.

added_for_evidence.source: the MiniCPM5 tokenizer's own chat template, taken verbatim from a MiniCPM5 checkpoint of the same family (16A3B RL ckpt)
added_for_evidence.why: The defect is that this template prefills the opening '<think>' into the prompt when enable_thinking=true, so the generated response carries only the closing tag and the paired regex in extract_non_reasoning_content matches nothing. Without the template in the workspace the agent could not observe that prefill, and the task would not be solvable from the shipped evidence alone. The file is byte-identical to the tokenizer asset; no metric or log was changed.
